entries.title: Psalms 31:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I put my trust; let me never be ashamed; deliver me in Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 31:2
segments: Bow down Your ear to me; deliver me quickly; be my strong rock, a fortress to save me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:3
segments: For You [are] my rock and my fortress; and for Your name's sake lead me and guide me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:4
segments: Bring me out of the net that they hid for me, for You [are] my strength.

entries.title: Psalms 31:5
segments: Into Your hand I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.

entries.title: Psalms 31:6
segments: I have hated those who take heed to lying vanities; but I trust in the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 31:7
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in Your mercy; for You have looked on my affliction; You have known my soul in troubles;

entries.title: Psalms 31:8
segments: and have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy; You have set my feet in a broad place.

entries.title: Psalms 31:9
segments: Have mercy on me, O LORD, for I am in trouble; my eye has become old with grief, my soul and my belly.

entries.title: Psalms 31:10
segments: For my life is ending with grief, and my years with sighing; my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones have wasted away.

entries.title: Psalms 31:11
segments: I was a reproach among all my foes, but especially among my neighbors, and a fear to my friends; those who saw me outside fled from me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:12
segments: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind; I am like a broken vessel.

entries.title: Psalms 31:13
segments: For I have heard the slander of many; fear [is] on every side; because of their plottings together against me, they planned to take away my life.

entries.title: Psalms 31:14
segments: But I trusted in You, O LORD; I said, You [are] my God.

entries.title: Psalms 31:15
segments: My times [are] in Your hand; deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

entries.title: Psalms 31:16
segments: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me in Your mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 31:17
segments: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called on You; Let the wicked be ashamed; let them be silent in the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 31:18
segments: Let the lying lips be put to silence; [the lips] which speak proudly against the righteous, with pride and scorn.

entries.title: Psalms 31:19
segments: How great [is] Your goodness, which You have laid up for those who fear You; You have worked for those who trust in You before the sons of men!

entries.title: Psalms 31:20
segments: You shall hide them in the secrecy of Your presence from the pride of man; You shall hide them in a shelter away from the strife of tongues.

entries.title: Psalms 31:21
segments: Blessed [is] the LORD; for He has worked His mercy wondrously in a besieged city.

entries.title: Psalms 31:22
segments: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before Your eyes; surely You heard the voice of my cries, when I cried to You.

entries.title: Psalms 31:23
segments: O love the LORD, all you saints of His; the LORD preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewards the proud doer.

entries.title: Psalms 31:24
segments: Be strong, and He will make your heart stronger, all you who hope in the LORD.
